```sql
SELECT
    c.name                AS customer_id,
    c.customer_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT si.name)              AS invoice_count,
    SUM(si.base_grand_total)             AS total_invoiced
FROM "tabSales Invoice" si
JOIN "tabCustomer" c
  ON c.name = si.customer
WHERE si.docstatus = 1
  AND COALESCE(si.territory, c.territory) = 'Germany'
GROUP BY c.name, c.customer_name
ORDER BY total_invoiced DESC;
```

```sql

JOIN "tabCustomer" c
```

```sql
SELECT sii.item_group,
       SUM(sii.base_net_amount) AS total_value
FROM "tabSales Invoice Item" sii
JOIN "tabSales Invoice" si
  ON si.name = sii.parent AND sii.parenttype = 'Sales Invoice'
JOIN "tabCustomer" c
  ON c.name = si.customer
WHERE si.docstatus = 1
  AND c.territory = 'Karnataka'
GROUP BY sii.item_group
ORDER BY total_value DESC
LIMIT 1;
```

```sql
SELECT
    sii.item_group,
    SUM(sii.base_net_amount) AS total_value
FROM "tabSales Invoice" si
JOIN "tabSales Invoice Item" sii
       ON sii.parent = si.name
      AND sii.parenttype = 'Sales Invoice'
JOIN "tabCustomer" c
       ON c.name = si.customer
JOIN "tabTerritory" t
       ON t.name = c.territory
JOIN "tabTerritory" root
       ON root.name = 'Karnataka'
      AND t.lft >= root.lft
      AND t.rgt <= root.rgt
WHERE si.docstatus = 1
  AND si.is_return = 0
GROUP BY sii.item_group
ORDER BY total_value DESC
LIMIT 1;
```

```sql
SELECT 
  "tabItem Group"."name",
  SUM("tabSales Invoice Item"."base_amount") AS total_value
FROM "tabSales Invoice Item"
JOIN "tabSales Invoice" ON "tabSales Invoice Item"."parent" = "tabSales Invoice"."name"
JOIN "tabCustomer" ON "tabSales Invoice"."customer" = "tabCustomer"."name"
JOIN "tabItem" ON "tabSales Invoice Item"."item_code" = "tabItem"."name"
JOIN "tabItem Group" ON "tabItem"."item_group" = "tabItem Group"."name"
WHERE "tabSales Invoice"."docstatus" = 1
  AND "tabCustomer"."territory" = 'Karnataka'
GROUP BY "tabItem Group"."name"
ORDER BY total_value DESC
LIMIT 1;
```
